title: Conservation of Energy
summary: Energy transforms but the total never changes: falling objects, pendulums, skate parks and where 'lost' energy goes.

cbse.chapter: Exploration (2026) Ch 7: Work, Energy and Simple Machines

objectives: I can state the law of conservation of energy.
I can use PE lost = KE gained to find speeds.
I can explain energy 'losses' as transfers to heat and sound.
misconceptions: Energy gets used up and disappears.
A pendulum stops because it runs out of energy.
Heavier objects land at higher speeds.
